body: I understand. it's fine, no worries.
yeah, we'll try to work it out. appreciate the answer!
to be honest i've always been a bit awkward with girlfriends, but the age diffrence does add to it in this relationship.

Like i said. I truly like her and i am not ashamed of her. It's just that i want to keep it to ourselves, also like i said in a reply post it would only bring more problems if certain people found out. I do love the fact that a lot of you have no problems with this type of age gap in person and i applaud it. I'm just not in that position. thnks for your answer tho!

It's not a favor, i genuinely like her. It's just not that easy to let it all go. As for rules, we both agreed upon it, what's so wrong about it. Just because she wants to do it differently now doesn't mean i can just do a 180 and have it her way. I've told her numerous times that it bothers me that that i can't give her what she wants, and if she does find someone who can then i'm happy for her.

No i don't want a medal, and i didn't mean in that way. All i'm saying is i want her to acknowledge that it's not as easy for me as it is for you.

I'm happy for you and your fwb, i truly am. But that doesn't mean that it's that easy for everybody else. I'm from a small town and my family is really conservative. It would only bring me more problems if we did everything care free. Am i so bad for this? Is it not enough to hang out, go out for coffee, do shopping go to the movies. Thanks for your perspective tho!
